variants.name: general
variants.rationale: Replaces open-ended thinking with a compact plan-then-verify loop: restate the output shape, plan briefly, and check the plan against every public example before coding, which targets small-model drift and rambling.

variants.name: coding
variants.rationale: Pins generation to the harness contract: read only from the dictionary argument, never hardcode or print, return a native value of the expected type, and handle empty and minimal inputs first.

note: proposals only; the winner is chosen by the pre-registered search
